messages.content_text:
Jan 5 Notes:


Today was the first viable trading day of the year and price was very choppy. I wanted to see price either rally off of open or drop down to previous week lows and price looked like it was going down off of open, but then just started consolidating and there was no possibility for trading today. (Screenshot 1)
,
There was one trade that was a good entry, but it didn’t play out very well and I didn’t take it. Price made it’s initial move down after open and the retraced to the ote and entered a 5min gap while making a 1min rejection block. This I would consider a good entry, but it didn’t hit any potential tp’s. If I had a set 50pt tp it would get hit, but I don’t think I would have. (Screenshot 2)
,

messages.content_text:
2 Trades Today same thesis.
Daily RB CE
.705 FIB
15m FVG CE
5m CISD

Was a strong looking level so I had a limit set there before open.
Open ended up sweeping right through it and stopping me
I still liked the idea was just silly limiting at open
We had a strong rejection from that area leaving a 1m wick.
Wasnt considered a RB because it closed green but with the opening volatility I liked it.
We also had a ton of LRL below us to target.
The next candle came up and rejected CE of the 1m wick perfectly so I entered short.

Honestly Im very happy how today went. First day of the new year and we killed it.
Had a good analysis and picked the best level for the day and executed on it.
Made our money and logged out my accounts.
Glad I did because rest of the day was pretty choppy and saw people taking losses.

We gonna carry this momentum and discipline with this through the new year. 
This is my year i KNOW IT we are going to fucking kill it, stay disciplined and focused and make the dreams come true.

I was bearish because of the  relative equal session lows near the 00:00 KO that hadn’t really been traded much below. I also noticed that NQ was trading inside a 15min bearish gap where CE lined up with .705 on the fib from expansion leg lower Monday. I was looking for an SMT at Friday’s NY AM High before looking for an entry trigger and got it. I then scaled down to 1min and found a breaker block formation. Once it finished forming I set a limit for CE of breaker with first TP at a 1:3, 2nd TP was 00:00 KO and 3rd TP was London and Asia lows. My first TP got hit so I began trailing stops following the trend. The rest of my position ended up getting stopped out in 39pts profit. Ultimately this was a 1:3 RR win for me, I followed all my rules and think this was a pretty decent setup. Thoughts? @boy
